Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Words at once and Linger.** With the **World** layout, **Lyrics → Position** now has two new sliders: **Words at once** (1 to 10) sets how many words float around you, and **Linger** sets how slowly sung words fade away. When there are too many words, the oldest one now fades out quickly instead of vanishing all at once.

### Better

- **Floating words look like a collage.** In the World layout, long words now float bigger and little ones smaller, in a tighter cluster.
- **Easier to read on the painted skies.** On the **Synthwave** and **Moonlight** skies the lyrics now get a darker shadow and halo, so they no longer fade into the bright sky.
